title: Unify mutate_state field allowlists into one descriptor
description: Tech-debt review finding. packages/core/src/state/mutateState.ts defines writable columns twice as membership Sets and type-dispatch Sets which must hand-sync with schema.ts. Replace with a single per-table field descriptor deriving both. The allowlist is load-bearing for SQL safety. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
close_reason: Refactor landed in PR #56: parallel membership Sets and type-dispatch Sets collapsed into a single FieldDescriptor record per writable table. Allowlist is still SQL-safety-load-bearing and still hand-synced with schema.ts, but only in one place now.
